Ligand 1 is the acetyl probe, whose cyclopropane CH at atom 17 is bonded to the carbonyl at atom 15 - the anchor for the best cap. Last blind episode of the generation. Everything now turns on activity per unit of drug-likeness: jnk3 is capped near 0.61 and bromine holds the lead at 0.60 only because it is the one top group that does not wreck QED. The candidates I have in flight all try to beat it by being lighter - nitrile, vinyl, dimethylamino, cyclopropyl. A difluoromethyl adds the missing point between methyl and trifluoromethyl. Methyl at 0.49 is too small and trifluoromethyl at 0.61 is right, so the interesting question is where in that range the transition happens; difluoromethyl sits between them in both bulk and electron withdrawal, and at 303 Da with LogP around 3.8 it is 43 Da lighter and notably less greasy than the bromine molecule. If activity tracks bulk as cleanly as the scan suggests, it should land near 0.58 and compete directly on Phi.
